addressing_rules.region_ids: P001 through P102 in page/system left-to-right print order, without repeat expansion.
addressing_rules.coordinates: Frozen page pixels; bbox [x0,y0,x1,y1), barlines_x_px in page coordinates.
addressing_rules.capacity: Rational quarter-note units; shared bar capacity for both piano staves and each independent voice; unprinted silence does not create printed rests.
addressing_rules.repeats: P006 through P030 repeat; P005 and P031 are adjacent half-bar regions outside the repeated section.
addressing_rules.system_breaks: Every system has a closing barline. No split bars or cadenzas.
addressing_rules.fingerings: Omit from delivery; do not count as events.

staff_voice_capacity_rule: Each independent voice on each staff has the region capacity in measure_capacities_q. Retain simultaneous voices and printed rests; shorter voices may contain unprinted silence.
